title: Rail registry and selection
spec: Add src/rails/registry.ts: RailRegistry with register(rail), get(id), and select(offerRails: string[], preferred?: string[]) returning the first implemented rail both sides support (normalize ids with tclk normalizeRailIds; stubs count as NOT implemented — detect via a static `implemented = false` you add to the stub classes). Unknown ids throw, like tclk does.
done: select() picks paper over stubs, honours preference order, and throws on unknown rail ids.
